text:
anya: quick sync: we saw a drift pattern on int4 where the model slowly injects spurious named entities after ~200 tokens. differs from the acute dropout we saw with quant noise before. thinking this is KV-cache error accumulation + low-bit rounding bias. ideas?

sara: interesting. could be sign/scale propagation in cached kvs. long-running sessions will amplify tiny biases. two orthogonal fixes: (a) per-step de-noising of kv after N steps, (b) guardrail: switch to int8/fp8 after token threshold.

tomas: +1. for (a) we can implement a lightweight checksum+resync: store a fingerprint per-kv-chunk and compare against baseline at checkpoint intervals. if mismatch -> invalidate recent N tokens of cache and refill from model (cold fetch). cheap and non-invasive.

jeff: API surface question: should resync be automatic or opt-in per-tenant? my vote: automatic but rate-limited; expose a metric `kv_resync_count` and a per-route knob `kv_resync_policy: [off,auto,aggressive]`. Docs + console toggle.

mike: ops: if auto resync causes latency spikes, we need an emergency off switch. suggest `precision_safety: { halt_int4_on_resync: true }` or similar. Also add `x-effective-precision` header so we can correlate.

sara: for the de-noising approach: algorithm sketch - at every 128 tokens compute moving mean + variance of kv activations; if variance increases beyond calibrated threshold, perform laplacian smoothing step on kv values. small runtime cost but should stabilize drift. we need a perf microbench.

anya: i like a layered approach: conservative guardrail + nonblocking de-noise. sequence: detect -> sample -> if persistent -> resync/invalidate -> if still bad -> route to int8. avoids knee-jerk switches.

tomas: sampling: add a sampler that takes 0.5% of int4 traffic and always evaluates against fp16 baseline in the background. sampler stores slices and returns `deg_delta` to metrics. endpoint stub: `POST /internal/sample?rate=0.005&len=512` with body: { "route": "/v1/generate" } (placeholder).

rachel: obs: create a dashboard tile for per-precision kv_resync_count, deg_delta by seq bucket, and latency p95 during resync windows. alerting: page if resync_count spikes >50/min AND median deg_delta >0.08.

jeff: contract detail: introduce `precision_hint` in request metadata (SDK + Console) so customer can request preferred lane but runtime can still override. header example: `x-precision-hint: int4` and response header `x-effective-precision: int8` when fallback occurs. put into SDK changelog.

mike: playbook stub for oncall: 1) check sampler anomalies 2) inspect kv_resync_count and last resync reason 3) if resync_count high and latency regressions -> flip `kv_resync_policy` to off for affected tenant 4) enable route-level `precision_hint` override to int8 for 30m 5) collect failing slices and create calibration job ticket.

sara: offline work items: - perf microbench for de-noise step - calibrate variance thresholds per-model - implement fingerprint/resync proto - add sampler eval harness - add integration test that simulates longctx drift

anya: volunteers?

sara: i'll take de-noise microbench + integration test.

tomas: i'll implement fingerprint/resync proto + sampler endpoint.

jeff: i'll add headers + Console toggle + API schema.

mike: i'll write the oncall playbook and short checklist.

rachel: dashboards and alert rules are on me.

ops-bot: deploy hint: resync-proto branch CI passing. staging rollout starts 2026-04-02T09:00Z. :rocket:

anya: ok team. lets keep thresholds conservative initially. i'll follow up with a short RFC patch that lists the new knobs + metric names. thanks! :thumbsup:
